people.jehoiachin.relations.text: He is Jehoiakim’s son. His mother and officials share the deportation.

chapters.3.meaning.text: The crossing helps the people trust Joshua as they trusted Moses. The exact crossing place remains uncertain.

chapters.1.lds.text: The Church’s Bible Dictionary reports the JST: “the Songs of Solomon are not inspired writings.” How does the woman answer those who stare at her skin?
